readerTask: Count the cells in a two-by-two grid.

article.title: Count the cells in a two-by-two grid
article.description: Multiply two rows by two columns to count four cells.
article.markdown:
# Count grid cells

A two-by-two grid has four cells.

## Calculation

Multiply two rows by two columns: 2 × 2 = 4. See the [calculation notes](/guide/calculation).

claims.text: A two-by-two grid has four cells.

calculation.assumptions: Exactly two rows and two columns.
calculation.reproduction: Multiply 2 by 2; the saved artifact is examples/calculation.json.
